_comment: The find-us section: contact rows, opening hours and the map. Email, phone and address come from site.json so they are defined once. These hours are the single source of truth for opening times — the rest of the site says only "OPEN 7 DAYS" rather than restating them, so there is nothing to keep in sync. The Beer Garden's food & beverage hours are separate and live in the Our Spaces section.
